Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Huckleberries

Huckleberries appear as an important part of Shinnecock food life, gathered with other berries and used in pies. The catalogue names dwarf and blue huckleberries and connects berry knowledge with woodland edges.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock residential territories; Shinnecock cemetery; West Woods; The Point.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 18. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
